steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} (and the code and quests it cites). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card: numbered test cases with hand-checked expected values (the circle from body positions, the detour and the sight-only case, the lap simulation on the real estate routes), and a who-touches-what table. Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source and data files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file(s) the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else, including the real-MuJoCo Node test (load MuJoCo with js/require as test/pm/creature_mujoco_test.cljs does). The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). Check: with no creature the walker code path and plans are unchanged; the creature goes through the same senses as walkers; it is never planned or pushed; the circle covers every capsule; no species names in code; the lap test uses the real estate routes. Write the review to {run}/review.md (at most 5 ranked findings).
